rules.name: START GAME IF WAITING FOR PLAYERS
PLAYER MENU CONTROLS (JUMP AND CROUCH, CHANGE HERO/READY)
PLAYER MENU CONTROLS (ABILITY 2, OBJECTIVE TYPE VOTE)
PREVENT PLAYERS FROM LEAVING START EARLY
BOSS TELEPORT TO TARGET IF NOT USED
ZOMBIE GETS RESOURCE VALUE/OBJECTIVE GIVES POWERUPS
BIOWASTE HOLDER DIES, ORB IS QUEUED AND RESOURCE AMOUNT REMOVED
SPAWN SURVIVOR TO BE RESCUED OR COMPLETE OBJECTIVE
PLAYER SAYS GROUP UP TO SURVIVOR
EGG SWITCHES THE POSITION FOR YOU
REVIVE PLAYER OR ADVANCE DEATH TIMER
OBJECTIVE CHANGES AND PLAYER ENTITIES UPDATE
MOIRA & VENTURE INVIS WHILE USING SKILL
KILL BOTS THAT ARE STUCK OR ARE NOT MOVING
TELEPORT BOTS WHEN NOT USED FOR TOO LONG
BOT TAKES DAMAGE AND SWITCHES TARGETS
BOTS INFLICT DAMAGE OVER TIME (INFECTION LEVEL MANAGEMENT)
BRUTE, GLADIATOR, AND SMOLDER ALTERNATE ATTACK CONTROL
RIDER DETACH WHEN DEAD OR TARGET IS DEAD
RIDER DETATCH FROM TEAMMATES WHILE ALIVE
SMOLDER STAYS ENRAGE DURING BOSS EVENT
SUCCESSOR (DOOMFIST) HOLDS BLOCK IF TARGET USE ULTIMATE
BRUTE, GLADIATOR, SUCESSOR, ENSNARER AND PROTECTOR USE ABILITIY (MINIBOSS)
CHARGER, STRIKER, SUCCESSOR USE ULT ON POINT (MINIBOSS)
PLAYER INTERACT (1: OPEN SUPPLY DROP, 2: PICK UP POWER UP, 3: USE POWER UP)
BORN TO BATTLE PLAYER USES ABILITY CHARGE
BOLT STRIKE AND OVERCHARGE ARM ON DOUBLE CROUCH
ENHANCEMENT HUD and AUGMENT HUD (PERMANENT TABLES)
